text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Daring 
Tact, 
I joined her for some shopping 
at a local mall.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Um... maybe the daily goods floor? 
I need to pick up a hair clip and a tail 
brush...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Haaai! Daring Tact and Trainer. 
Shopping together?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Is that your shopping list? Mm-hmm... 
If that's what you need, the boutique on 
the third floor is much better. 
I was just heading there myself. Would you 
like to come with me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
May we really? 
We'd love to join you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Wow... What an amazing selection! 
They even carry imported items!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, quite the lineup, isn't it? 
There are lots of cute designs, too.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
As for what would suit your tail... 
perhaps brushes around here? Why not give 
one a try?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, I wonder which one would be best. 
Every single one leaves my hair silkier 
than what I use now, 
so it's hard to choose.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Excuse me, might I ask a quick 
question? 
You picked up that brush without 
hesitation— 
would you recommend it?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Another School
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Oh, this one? 
Yes, this series is wonderful! 
It hardly generates any static, and it 
leaves your tail so silky and shiny!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, look at that! Your tail really is 
glossy! 
Have you been using this series for a 
while?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Another School
text_block_list.text:
Yup! It's an import and kind of looks like 
a toy, 
but the results are incredible! 
It feels like you've swapped in a whole 
new tail!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it really that good...?! In that 
case, 
I'll take this one too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks to you, Win Marilyn, 
I was able to find something wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it! It was my pleasure. 
We've walked quite a bit, so are you 
tired? 
Let's take a break at a cafe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact & Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: —Ah!

When the three of us stepped into a cafe 
inside the mall... 
there sat the very same horsegirl 
we had encountered earlier in the 
boutique.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Why, hello again! 
Oh, is that the new frappe? How does it 
taste?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Another School
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, is that what caught your eye too? 
The strawberry sauce is quite sweet.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Then perhaps I'll go with 
chocolate. 
What will you two have?
choice_data_list:
(She sat down right at the table next to 
her like it was nothing!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then... 
Let's take a seat too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a trip with your friends? 
So that's why you were stocking up on all 
those things.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Another School
text_block_list.text:
Yup. You know how it is—you don't want to 
drag 
a bulky brush around on a trip. So I was 
picking up 
travel-sized brushes, cosmetics, and the 
like.

Win Marilyn and the visiting horsegirl 
chatted away so animatedly 
that you would never have guessed they had 
only just met.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: Where are you heading for your trip?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Another School
text_block_list.text:
Hokkaido! Places like Tomakomai, Hidaka, 
and Cape Erimo, 
out around there. Do you know where that 
is?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Oh! In that case, she's your girl. 
She knows the area inside and out. Right, 
Daring Tact?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. I know that area quite well. 
If you have any questions—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Another School
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?! That's a lifesaver~! 
I've looked up most of the tourist spots 
already... 
so tell me what foods I have to try!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Any of the seafood is delicious, 
so I recommend enjoying whatever is in 
season! 
You simply must try the genuine shishamo!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I'm sorry, that was probably far 
too plain a suggestion! 
Naturally, the soft-serve ice cream is 
delicious as well!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Another School
text_block_list.text:
No way, honestly all I had in mind for 
seafood was sushi, 
so this helps a ton! I really want to eat 
like a local~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so? If that's the case, 
you should definitely taste barfin 
flounder too!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Have you already decided on how you'll get 
around? 
Like your transportation methods?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl from Another School
text_block_list.text:
I have, but... could you take a look at it 
for me? 
To be honest, I've been worried that the 
itinerary might be pushing it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I would love to help 
make sure you enjoy Hokkaido to the 
fullest...!
choice_data_list:
(Looks like Daring Tact's nerves have 
eased up, too.)

(Looks like Daring Tact's nerves have 
eased up, too.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was so much fun...!
choice_data_list: You two were really hitting it off!
You two were really hitting it off!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I truly enjoyed myself. 
Back in Hidaka, there weren't many peers 
around my age...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And ever since coming here, I've almost 
exclusively spoken 
with students from the academy, so this 
felt so fresh...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Like Win Marilyn... I think I'd like 
to interact with all kinds of different 
people...
choice_data_list: That sounds great! Why not give it a try?
That sounds great! Why not give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
However, there is so much I don't know 
about how to strike up a conversation 
or maintain proper distance... The thought 
that I might make someone 
uncomfortable makes me hesitate...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Getting a feel for distance and starting 
conversations just takes practice! 
So it wouldn't do much good if I kept 
stepping in to bridge the gap—

True enough... Still, now that Daring Tact 
has found this spark of motivation, 
I want to do whatever I can to nurture 
it...!
choice_data_list: Let's head somewhere we can socialize!

How about trying to chat with people on 
social media?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! In that case, Trainer, 
will you find a place for us?
choice_data_list:
Of course! Could you give me some time, 
Daring Tact?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll gladly wait as long as it takes! 
I'm counting on you, Trainer.

She looks at me with eyes full of hope. 
I silently resolve to come up with a 
wonderful suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
People reply to complete strangers on 
social media all the time... 
I think that's a lovely idea!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Social media... I'm not very good at it, 
but if it's talking about things I love, 
like today...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it my all! 
Please allow me to report back if it goes 
well.
